nodes.intent: the upper town: the square, flights 1 and 2, the upper and middle streets, and the chapel, inn, smithy, weaver's and merchant's houses
nodes.note: x 54..94, z 96..149, floor 76 (its south end), open 20. This one piece draws everything inside it; buildings are not boxes. STREET PLACES: the square x 65..82 z 96..109 walk 84 (the party arrives here: spawn on the square between the chapel and the inn); flight 1 x 71..76 z 111..116, floor 80 rising to 84 at its north end; the upper street x 71..76 z 118..129 walk 80; flight 2 x 71..76 z 131..136, floor 76 rising to 80; the middle street x 71..76 z 138..149 walk 76, running on to the front at z 150. The one-cell rings between them (z 110, 117, 130, 137) are street. BUILDINGS (interior footprint, floor, clearance, roof courses and eaves, door): 1 the chapel, x 54..63 z 98..106, floor 84, clearance 6, roof 6 courses 1 eave, deepslate tiles, door on its east face at z 102 onto the square; a small stone chapel with a short tower, the first thing seen from the square. 2 the inn (the Lantern), x 84..94 z 97..107, floor 84, clearance 4, roof 6, 1, deepslate tiles, door west at z 102 onto the square; a wide timber-framed inn with lit windows. 3 the smithy, x 62..69 z 119..126, floor 80, clearance 4, roof 4, 1, shingles, door east at z 122; a forge with a chimney, open-fronted toward the street. 4 the weaver's house, x 78..84 z 118..128, floor 80, clearance 4, roof 5, 1, shingles, door west at z 123; a narrow house, cloth on the upper floor. 5 the merchant's house, x 60..69 z 139..148, floor 76, clearance 5, roof 5, 1, deepslate tiles, door east at z 143; the tallest house, a steep roof, a counting room. THE FRONT (south face, z 150): open air across the whole width, no parapet, no lintel, no wall. The middle terrace meets the lower town at walk 76 over x 59..78 (the street and the merchant's side); elsewhere along the front this place's edge stands 1 to 7 blocks above the fixed ground below (walk 73..75 at x 54..58, 75 falling to 69 over x 79..94), a visible drop. MATERIALS (one hand across the town): walls are stone bricks with cobblestone ground floors, spruce timber framing with white calcite infill above; roofs are deepslate tiles (slate) where stated, dark oak stairs (shingles) on the rest, every roof with one block of eaves where its frame allows, its courses chosen as ceil((W - 1) / 2) 45-degree stair courses over a span W; the street is cobblestone paving with stone-brick kerbs and stone-brick stairs at the flights; retaining walls between terraces are stone bricks with mossy courses at the foot. LIGHT is placed with the place: lanterns on the street's kerb posts at every flight and at every door, every house's windows lit from inside; every walkable cell, indoors and out, lit by this piece itself. THE GROUND: every terrace stands above the next behind a retaining wall this piece draws; the hillside beside the street is stepped turf following the heightmap (pads at walk plane - 1 under every street place, house and its one-cell ring, falling half a block a column between them), and a house's downhill wall stands on that ground with its floor level with its street. A piece's space is one floor, so every terrace is its own space and every flight a stair edge whose via is its treads; hillside a body can stand on is the via of a stair edge between terraces or is fenced and declared no_body. THE STREET runs due south down the hill, six blocks wide, x 71..76 (centre line x 73-74), in flat terraces four blocks apart joined by flights of four steps, each flight six wide and six long, its floor the lower terrace and its treads rising to the upper at its north end. Every house stands one cell from the street (that cell is its facade), its door a standard 1 x 2 door centred on its street face. All coordinates here are world coordinates, x east, z south; walk planes are the y a body stands at (the surface block is one under).
